description:
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  reset
 - input  w
 - output z

The module should implement the state machine shown below:

  A (0) --0--> B
  A (0) --1--> A
  B (0) --0--> C
  B (0) --1--> D
  C (0) --0--> E
  C (0) --1--> D
  D (0) --0--> F
  D (0) --1--> A
  E (1) --0--> E
  E (1) --1--> D
  F (1) --0--> C
  F (1) --1--> D

Assume all sequential logic is triggered on the positive edge of the
clock.


The reset input is active-high synchronous and resets the state to A.
The output z is a Moore output: z=1 in E and F, and z=0 otherwise.
